With scope: 'worker' each attempt gets a new browser context, and a Kernel profile applies only to the browser's default context, so it has no effect.
With scope: 'attempt' each attempt leases a new browser and runs in its default context, so the profile applies.

Return a blocked verdict with STEP_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, STEP_TIMEOUT or CANCELLED.
Use them only when the budget is spent, the deadline passed or the test was cancelled.
The runner refuses any other use with MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.
A passed verdict that carries a code is also refused with MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.
